## Description

Briefly describe the purpose of this pull request, the problem it solves, and the motivation behind the change.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards and conventions.
- [ ] I have verified that all existing backend tests pass (`./mvnw test`).
- [ ] I have added new unit or integration tests for the changes introduced.
- [ ] I have verified that the frontend builds cleanly without errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation in `docs/` or `README.md` if applicable.
- [ ] My changes do not expose any secrets, credentials, or private configuration.
